what: When the title text changes, letters shared by the old and new names don’t vanish but slide to their new positions in .65s (.15s late), the remaining old letters push up 101% and flip over −90° on the x-axis in .68s, and new letters rise from 40% below · −40° · transparent, landing in .75s after a .3s delay — all curves are cubic-bezier(.56,.15,0,.99). Even when the name changes, the overlapping letters stay, so it looks like one word being rewritten

options.move: Duration of the same text sliding (s), default .65
options.each-move: Extra delay per identical character (seconds), default 0 — .01 for page-transition titles
options.out: Duration (s) for the old text to move out, default .68 — page-turn title .61
options.each-out: Delay per previous character (seconds), default 0 — page-turn title .016
options.in: Duration (seconds) for new text to settle in, default .75 — page-turn title .6
options.wait: Delay before new text starts (sec), default .3 — page-turn title .25
options.each-in: Delay per new character (s), default 0 — page-turn heading .015
options.fx:retitle: In the element { detail: { text } } Pass it in and it switches to that text

use:
Studio Name

— el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fx:retitle', { detail: { text: 'Next Name' } }))
